family: F6 60-s-left burst, maker sells the favourite
rule: BTC 5m: at window open + 239.0 s, favourite = token with mid >= 50c in the book seen; post-only SELL 5 favourite at its best ask (= BUY underdog at 1-ask), cancel decided at +240.5 s; hold the underdog leg to settlement
